title: Claude Desktop app data
whyItMatters: Claude Desktop keeps a local configuration and cached app state here. It shows the desktop app was used on this Mac and which local tools it was allowed to start.
source: Model Context Protocol docs for Claude Desktop: config and logs under ~/Library/Application Support/Claude - https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2026-07-28/develop/connect-local-servers
notes: Config and cached app state used by Claude Desktop, including claude_desktop_config.json. MCP logs are under ~/Library/Logs/Claude and are not covered here. Conversations are account-based; nothing is opened.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Claude Desktop on this Mac so the account no longer keeps a signed-in session here.
steps: Quit Claude and move Claude to the Trash from Applications.
Delete the Claude folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local Claude configuration and cached app state from this Mac. Conversations stored with the account stay there.
cleanup.source: Claude Help Center, Install Claude Desktop: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop
